overview: Forcefields and hologram-like materials should read as a thin energy shell with strong view-dependent edges, controlled opacity, and secondary patterning that never turns into an opaque wall.
common_failure_modes: opaque center killing the forcefield read
too much roughness making it feel solid
plain glowing sprite with no shell depth
screen-door crack pattern taking over the shell
capture_review_checklist: Front shot keeps a readable shell.
Three-quarter shot shows patterning without destroying transparency.
Grazing shot is the strongest edge-read frame.
The shell never reads as a solid opaque wall in any capture.

build_material_fresnel_lane.goal: Establish the shell silhouette and edge emphasis before adding depth fade or patterning.

build_material_depth_mask_lane.goal: Introduce shell falloff and controlled depth softness without losing the silhouette.

build_material_crack_mask_lane.goal: Add restrained secondary patterning only after silhouette and opacity are stable.

branch_restart_triggers: opaque center killing the forcefield read
plain glowing sprite with no shell depth
